status: note (a one-off analysis by the loop manager; nothing changed in the bot)
request: From the loop manager, not a request of yours: I pooled every fresh Nightmare 1 game from 0:00 in the logs, all arms and loops (145 games). Of the 122 that died or were played to 4:00, 58 reached 4:00 (48%). By seed: s31 9 of 22, s32 8 of 19, s33 11 of 23, s34 9 of 14, s35 11 of 16. Within each of these five seeds I compared the games that reached 4:00 with those that died, by what their logs show at 1:00 and at 2:00. At 1:00 they look alike (same level, chests, weapons, health lost within 20); only the distance walked is lower in the survivors on all five seeds (140 to 1000 units). At 2:00 they differ on all five seeds: the survivors had spent less of their steps on evade goals (7 to 44 points less; pooled medians 32% of steps against 52%), had walked about 1000 units less and had lost 10 to 55 less health. On four of five seeds they were a level higher, held 1 to 4 more weapon levels and spent more steps on explore and spot goals; on three of five they had opened more chests, on none fewer. Damage dealt by 2:00 did not differ.
why: This is a correlation, not a cause: losing health makes the planner pick evade, so evading may only be a sign of a game already in trouble. The other reading is that between 1:00 and 2:00 evading costs the levels, chests and shrines that survive the 2:00 boss. evadeSeconds and the planner's goal text decide how much Tibo evades, so a paired test from 0:00 can tell the two readings apart. If a pooled table like this would help every iteration, ask for it.
